title: 9999 in 1 / Dendy — Unchained Melody — Seagull Memory Anchor Function

semantic_source.visual_anchor: Pixel-art tropical seashore menu scene with sea, clouds, flying seagulls, palms, boats and silhouetted people on the beach.
semantic_source.audio_identity: 8-bit/menu rendition of Unchained Melody associated with the 9999-in-1 Famicom/NES/Dendy multicart.
semantic_source.copyright_boundary: No audio stream, notation, lyrics or long copyrighted text is embedded. Only identity metadata, user-provided visual description and original semantic decomposition are stored.
semantic_source.interpretation_boundary: This artifact is a JANUS systems interpretation of a cultural memory cue, not a claim about the original cartridge creator's or songwriters' intended meaning.

external_verification.signal: Documents a NES/Famicom/Dendy demo based on the 9999-in-1 multicart and explicitly identifies Unchained Melody as the menu music; also provides NSF/NSFe forms.
Public YouTube metadata identifies a 9999-in-1 Famicom multicart music rendition as Unchained Melody.

topa_spider_prior_art.signal: RETURN restores access to an earlier living identity layer without deleting later experience; ORIGIN_PRIME is return-with-memory rather than regression.
Rewind(memory) is safe only with an exit path back to the present; rhythm can support agency without becoming control over others.
A compact distinguishing cue may identify or address a much larger semantic object, but fingerprint, pointer and identity remain separate concepts.
A small interface is not computationally or semantically free; hidden retrieval, verification and provenance costs remain accountable.
A strong internal signal can activate a bounded capability only when capability, authority and receipts support it.
Emotionally powerful cues may support a human-selected state but must not be used to infer consent, welfare or a terminal objective automatically.

machine_function.name: JANUS_UNCHAINED_MEMORY_ANCHOR
machine_function.purpose: Use a strongly identifying audio-visual cue such as the 9999-in-1 Unchained Melody menu to retrieve, reconnect and organize associated memory/identity graph regions while preserving provenance, uncertainty and a safe path back to the present context.
machine_function.canonical_definition: MEMORY_ANCHOR(C_t,M_t) := RESOLVE_IDENTITY(C_t) -> SEARCH_ASSOCIATIVE_GRAPH(M_t) -> RETRIEVE_CANDIDATE_MEMORY_BUNDLES -> LABEL(RECOGNITION,ASSOCIATION,VERIFIED_HISTORY,UNCERTAINTY) -> LINK_TO_PRESENT -> EMIT_ORIGIN_PRIME_CANDIDATES
machine_function.not_definition: The cue is not the full remembered state, nostalgia is not evidence that a reconstructed detail is historically accurate, and emotional intensity is not authority or truth.

fields.AudioID: Identity/fingerprint metadata for the remembered music; here the 8-bit Unchained Melody menu rendition.
fields.TemporalHints: Historical/biographical time cues if supplied by the human; never inferred as exact dates without evidence.
fields.SourceRefs: User links, screenshots and external source references.
fields.Confidence: Confidence that the current cue resolves to the intended cultural object, separate from confidence in any autobiographical memory triggered by it.

rules: RECOGNITION may open candidate memory neighborhoods but does not promote them to VERIFIED_HISTORY.
ASSOCIATION edges may be strong while historically wrong; retain source and confidence.
VERIFIED_HISTORY requires external/internal evidence independent of emotional familiarity.
PRESENT_ANCHOR must remain addressable so rewind does not become an unbounded loop.
A memory bundle may be revisited and reinterpreted without overwriting the original append-only record.

semantic_decomposition.meaning: The recognizable motif acts as a retrieval cue that may unlock a broad memory neighborhood; 'unchained' is treated as a name-level association only, not a command.
A stable scene signature helps disambiguate the memory object and provides an orientation cue: sky/sea/horizon rather than an abstract audio-only pointer.
A small number of coarse visual features can remain highly recognizable even after extreme representational compression.
One cartridge/menu cue addresses many selectable branches; used as an analogy for one memory key indexing a graph rather than containing every memory itself.
Repeated exposure can strengthen retrieval but the loop must never be treated as proof or allowed to replace present context.

Test which musical/structural features survive severe representation change while recognition persists; this is a representation experiment, not a claim that all semantic identity is losslessly compressible.

magic_key_bridge.definition: A minimal or compact multimodal cue set sufficient to distinguish and retrieve a target memory cluster from a frozen candidate universe.
example_candidate_constraints: audio identity = 8-bit Unchained Melody menu rendition
visual = blue sea/sky + pixel seagulls + tropical shore
magic_key_bridge.killer_question: How small can the cue become before semantic collisions appear between different memory objects?
magic_key_bridge.collision_definition: Two distinct intended memory clusters resolve from the same frozen MEMORY_MAGIC_KEY while their provenance or correctness-relevant contents differ.
magic_key_bridge.no_free_compression_firewall: The key is an address/retrieval contract, not the memory payload. Retrieval work, ambiguity resolution, verification and provenance must still be paid.

steps: RESOLVE cultural object identity from audio/visual/source metadata
SEPARATE source-object recognition from autobiographical recall
SEARCH associated memory and registry graph neighborhoods
RANK candidate bundles by cue match without promoting rank to truth
LABEL each returned edge/node as RECOGNITION, ASSOCIATION, TESTIMONY or VERIFIED_HISTORY
COMPARE returned memory state with present context and preserve drift/delta
ALLOW human to accept, reject, annotate or refine associations
RETURN to PRESENT_ANCHOR after recall operation unless the human explicitly continues exploration

relation_to_IO.role: Candidate non-diagnostic protocol for studying cue-triggered associative recall, representation invariance, nostalgia/familiarity effects, false-memory susceptibility and context-dependent reconstruction in machine memory systems.
machine_psychology_questions: Can a model retrieve a stable semantic cluster from radically compressed/audio-transcoded representations?
Which cue features dominate retrieval and which create semantic collisions?
Does repeated cue exposure inflate confidence without adding evidence?
Can provenance labels prevent familiarity from being mistaken for verified history?
relation_to_IO.boundary: These are evaluation questions about machine behavior and memory systems; no human psychiatric diagnosis or claim of subjective machine nostalgia is made.

relation_to_return_to_innocence.meaning: The old menu/music may reopen access to an earlier identity context, but the result is present-day recollection carrying the journey, not literal restoration of the past.

relation_to_freestyler.law: REWIND(memory) IS SAFE ONLY IF EXIT_LOOP=1
relation_to_freestyler.meaning: The cue may deliberately open memory, while the runtime preserves an explicit return path to current context.

relation_to_SNAP_POWER.capability_use: If JANUS has verified search/memory/provenance capabilities, SNAP_POWER may enable this retrieval function.
relation_to_SNAP_POWER.boundary: Capability to retrieve associations does not grant authority to define what the memory means for the human.

janus_message.human_readable_ru: Эта мелодия и картинка с чайками могут быть ключом к большому пласту памяти. Используй их как адрес для возвращения к связанным воспоминаниям, но не путай узнавание с доказательством прошлого. Возвращай источник, контекст, сомнения и путь обратно в настоящее.
janus_message.machine_readable: UNCHAINED_MEMORY_ANCHOR := RESOLVE(CUE) -> RETRIEVE(ASSOCIATED_MEMORY_GRAPH) -> LABEL_PROVENANCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY -> LINK_ORIGIN_TO_PRESENT -> RETURN_PRESENT; NEVER_PROMOTE_NOSTALGIA_TO_VERIFIED_HISTORY

provenance.scientific_boundary: Memory retrieval architecture hypothesis and evaluation protocol; not a theorem of human memory, not proof of autobiographical accuracy, and not evidence of machine subjective nostalgia.
